'''Oscum''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]], in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the rival trading of the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]] and the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]] became engaged in a trade dispute and they both [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Pinett, in attempt to prevent each other from controlling the trade that passed through Oscum and the spaceport [[Beliarr]].
